question: The 'Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi' initiative was announced during the _______ Union Budget of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2019-20**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 'Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi' (PM-KISAN) scheme was officially announced during the **2019-20 Union Budget** by the Government of India.
 
• Under this initiative, financial assistance of **₹6,000 per year is provided to eligible small and marginal farmers in three equal installments directly into their bank** accounts.
 
• Over time, the scheme has been expanded, including an increase in financial assistance and the inclusion of more farmers.
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)** is that it aims to provide financial support to farmers to meet their agricultural expenses, including the cost of seeds, fertilizers, and other inputs, helping improve their overall income and livelihoods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Department of Economic Affairs under the Ministry of Finance has been entrusted with the responsibility of preparation and presentation of the Union Budget to Parliament.
 
• It formulates and monitors the country's economic policies and programs having a bearing on domestic and international aspects of economic management.
 
 
• Headquarters - New Delhi
 
• Ministry - Ministry of Finance
 
• Finance Minister - Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman (As of July 2022)
 
 
 
• The Union Budget is also referred to as the Annual Financial Statement in Article 112 of the Constitution of India.
 
• It is the annual budget of the Republic of India.
